answer: Each identity posts a 7-coin bond. A watch system called lantern scans the ocean of agent actions from a fixed ledge of checkpoint servers: if two identities repeatedly trade, vote or attest within the same 2 seconds and pick identical counterparties over 20 rounds, they are merged as one and both bonds are slashed. One operator controlling 1,000 Sybils must run 1,000 separate schedulers with true random delays, distinct counterparties and separate proxies at about $18 monthly each ($18,000 monthly), plus lose 7,000 coins in bonds when synchrony is caught.
